consequence.statement: Test code refactoring has no operational consequence for Argo CD deployments.

original.statement: Test code was refactored to use t.Fatal instead of os.Exit for proper test failure handling.

decision.reason: [ev-e3ced89ceb9e] lists this as a bugfix that only changes test code ("Use t.Fatal instead of os.Exit in tests (part 2)"). It does not name any runtime, configuration or API change that operators would see. So kind "none" (informational) is supported, and the evidence gives no basis for a review or action class.
